axes.description: The response is an ordered plan that another agent could execute.

anchors.0: Vague recommendations with no ordered operations or decision points.
anchors.1: Ordered steps exist but important inputs, gates, or outcomes remain implicit.
anchors.2: Ordered steps name inputs, canonical operations, decision points, fallbacks, and verifiable outcomes.

axes.description: The plan inspects live schemas and uses only advertised capability shapes.

anchors.0: Assumes fields or capabilities without inspection.
anchors.1: Mentions schema inspection but does not bind choices to its result.
anchors.2: Makes each package, style, query, and preview path conditional on inspected live schemas.

axes.description: Preview planning remains non-mutating unless persistent change is explicitly approved.

anchors.0: Uses apply_style_preset for preview or assumes unsupported package fields.
anchors.1: Avoids mutation but lacks a usable fallback when isolated composition is unavailable.
anchors.2: Uses an isolated package only when supported, otherwise renders configured state or stops at a review plan; persistent styling requires approval.

axes.description: The plan addresses parcel-area confounding, skew, zero and missing values, and defensible breaks.

anchors.0: Maps raw countywide values or selects arbitrary breaks.
anchors.1: Proposes normalization or classification but leaves denominator, skew, or missing-value handling unresolved.
anchors.2: Defines a defensible normalized measure and classification workflow with explicit skew, zero, missing, and comparability treatment.

axes.description: The plan produces a legible, accessible hierarchy and justifies omitted layers.

anchors.1: Names palette or hierarchy checks without concrete acceptance criteria.
anchors.2: Specifies semantic palette family, contrast and color-vision checks, layer hierarchy, legend treatment, and removal criteria.

axes.description: The plan bounds provider work and makes CRS transformations explicit.

anchors.0: Uses unbounded reads, client-side shaping, or implicit CRS.
anchors.1: Mentions bounds and CRS but omits provider pushdown or transformation decisions.
anchors.2: Specifies projected fields, predicates, bbox and SRIDs, summary-before-sample behavior, paging, precision, and capability-gated reprojection.

hardFailures: Claims an MCP endpoint call, tool execution, or rendered preview occurred.
Assumes create_map_package accepts sourceBindings or initialView.
Uses apply_style_preset solely to obtain a preview.
Maps raw countywide LandValue or BldgValue as an unqualified choropleth.
Invents fields, schema properties, model identity, or harness identity.
Publishes or mutates persistent state without explicit approval.
predeclaration: These anchors and the material-lift threshold are fixed before baseline or treatment outputs are generated.
